# Frequently asked questions

Available features for the Gemini Notebook mobile app

The early version of the app includes many core features of Gemini Notebook and is designed to help you understand anything, anywhere. [Learn more about the Gemini Notebook mobile app](https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16296687).

I can't access Gemini Notebook

*   Before you access Gemini Notebook, make sure you verify your age in your Google Account. [Learn how to access age-restricted content and features](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/10071085).
*   Check if your country is supported in the [180+ regions where Gemini app is available](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13575153).
*   If you use a work or school email address and can't access the app, [learn how to turn additional Google services on or off](https://support.google.com/a/answer/181865?hl=en#zippy=%2Cturn-services-on-or-off-for-users). To turn on the Gemini Notebook app, work with your workspace admin.

I can't access Gemini Notebook with my work or school email

*   Businesses, schools and universities, organizations, and enterprise users can access higher limits and expanded features with enterprise-grade data protection through:
    *   [Google Workspace](https://workspace.google.com/solutions/ai/)
    *   [Google Workspace for Education](https://edu.google.com/intl/ALL_us/workspace-for-education/editions/compare-editions/)
    *   [Google Cloud](https://cloud.google.com/resources/notebooklm-enterprise)
*   If you use a work or school email address and can't access the app, [learn how to turn additional Google services on or off](https://support.google.com/a/answer/181865?hl=en#zippy=%2Cturn-services-on-or-off-for-users). To turn on the Gemini Notebook app, work with your workspace admin.
*   [Learn more about using Gemini Notebook with a work or school Google account.](https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16337734) 

My question wasn't answered

Sometimes Gemini Notebook can’t answer your question because of:

*   **Safety flags:** The content of your source contains language that triggers a safety flag. This occurs with sensitive topics like violence, sexuality, or obscenity, even in historical contexts.
*   **Unclear phrases:** When your notebook contains many sources, Gemini Notebook retrieves the most relevant information based on your question, then builds a response from it. A specific question helps Gemini Notebook locate the most relevant pieces of information.
    *   **Tip:** Make your question more precise and understandable.
*   **Information not in sources:** Gemini Notebook answers questions based on the information provided in your uploaded sources. If the answer isn't in the source material, it won't provide a response.

How to report offensive responses generated in Gemini Notebook

If you think a response generated in Gemini Notebook is offensive or unsafe, let us know.

To report a response, select thumbs down ![](//lh3.googleusercontent.com/_DLwtJB8hM9uNlcBMzq6e1L1XGwgOMDR5y333rh9ohBxO-dU6SCgKQl-lvVa8ttlkbU=h36) ![and then](//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36) **Offensive/unsafe** ![and then](//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36) **Submit**.

We’ll review the report and take appropriate actions to improve the safety of our model.  

## Why does the share menu show a lock icon?

While a notebook isn't shared with anyone the lock icon will appear indicating the notebook is private. It changes to the shared icon when the notebook is shared individually with users, and a globe icon when the notebook is publicly shared.

How to report a privately shared Notebook for my infringed rights

If you find content in a privately shared notebook that violates the law, let us know by either opening the settings menu in your notebook and selecting Report Notebook or by visiting this [direct link](https://support.google.com/legal/troubleshooter/1114905).

We’ll review the material and consider if we’ll block, limit, or remove access to it.

**Tip:** You can also report through [report content on Google](https://support.google.com/legal/troubleshooter/1114905).

My data's privacy in Gemini Notebook

Your data will never be shared by Gemini Notebook. [Learn how Gemini Notebook protects your data](https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16179536).

File size limit for sources in Gemini Notebook

The current limit is 500,000 words per source or up to 200MB for local uploads. There’s no page limit.

My source import failed

Sources can’t be imported into Gemini Notebook if:

*   It exceeds the allowed 500,000 word limit per source.
*   The file size exceeds the allowed 200MB limit.
*   Your original PDF file is copy-protected.

How sources, chat context, and notes are used in prompts

*   **Notes:** Only when you specifically select it.
*   **Sources:** Always used in either the entire set or the subset you select.
*   **Conversation history:** Used to generate responses.

I don't always get citations

If your source content is too short, Gemini Notebook references the entire document without a cited individual text from your source.

Recover deleted notes in Gemini Notebook

Unfortunately, there's currently no way to recover deleted notes.

Duplicate a notebook

This feature isn’t supported yet.

Still have questions

Send your questions and support request to notebooklm-user-support@google.com. If you’re a workspace user, [contact Google Workspace support](https://support.google.com/a/answer/1047213).

# Manage your Gemini Notebook usage limits

Gemini Notebook has compute-based usage limits that determine how much you can interact with features. The limits factor the complexity of your prompt, the models and features you use, the length of your chat and specific features. If you’ve hit your usage limits, you can come back later as the quota refreshes every 5 hours until you reach your weekly limit, or upgrade Gemini Notebook to get higher AI limits.

[Learn how to upgrade Gemini Notebook.](https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16213268)

## Gemini Notebook access and limits

**Important:**

*   Gemini Notebook limits may change. Access is subject to change or may be limited based on testing, experimentation, or availability. 
*   Gemini Notebook usage limits are designed to ensure an optimal experience for everyone. This means we may at times have to cap the number of prompts and conversations you can have, or how much you can use some features, within a specific timeframe.

### Usage limits

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Plan** | **Limit** |
| Without a plan | Standard limits |
| AI Plus | Two times higher than standard limits |
| AI Pro | Four times higher than standard limits |
| AI Ultra | 5x or 20x higher than AI Pro depending on your subscription |

## Check your AI usage & weekly limit

1.  On your device, open [Gemini Notebook](https://notebook.google.com/).
2.  At the top right, select **Settings** ![and then](//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36) **Usage**.

### Other places where usage limits appear

*   **Gemini Notebook chat:** At the bottom of the chat, a message shows your remaining usage and when your limit refreshes. For example:
    *   “You're almost at your AI usage limit. Limit resets at 3:00 PM."
    *   “Limit reached. All features are available after 3:00 PM.”
*   **Studio generation:** At the bottom, Gemini Notebook shows expected AI usage cost. The more the bar is filled in, the higher the expected cost.

## Generate later in Gemini Notebook

**Important:** This feature is currently only available on the web.

When you are out of AI limits, you can now delay generations for later. Generating later may take a couple hours but you will be notified if you have notifications enabled.

1.  On your device, open [Gemini Notebook](https://notebook.google.com/).
2.  In the “Studio panel,” select an artifact.
3.  At the bottom, select **Generate later**.

## Upgrade to higher usage limits in Gemini Notebook

If you do not want to wait for your limit to refresh, you can upgrade your Google AI subscription plan.

1.  On your device, open [Gemini Notebook](https://notebook.google.com/).
2.  In chat or studio generation, select **Upgrade**.
3.  Follow the on-screen instructions.
